title: Australian Strawberry Pavlova
description: A classic Australian dessert featuring meringue, whipped cream, and fresh strawberries.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°F (90°C) with a rack in the lower third.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a clean, dry bowl, beat egg whites until soft peaks form.
Gradually add granulated sugar, beating until stiff peaks form.
Spoon meringue onto prepared baking sheet, forming a round shape.
Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until crisp and dry.
In a separate bowl, whip heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Add vanilla extract and confectioners' sugar; whip until combined.
To assemble, place meringue on a serving plate, top with whipped cream, and arrange strawberries on top.
Dust with confectioners' sugar before serving.
